summary_text: Near-term catalyst: Q2 2026 earnings release scheduled for May 20, 2026. Citi placed AMD and ADI on 30-day positive catalyst watch list, citing AI/data center demand. ADI Buy rating with $400 PT from Citi; expects April and July quarter results to exceed estimates. AI/data center exposure now ~20% of ADI revenue. S&P Global Ratings upgraded issuer credit rating from A- to A on April 17, 2026 with stable outlook. Stock opened up 4.41% on Apr 23 on analyst upgrades ahead of earnings.
